svg.title: 24-hour hormone timeline
svg.desc: Seven hormone curves over one simulated day with three meals at 08:00, 12:30 and 18:30. Each curve is scaled to its own minimum and maximum.
svg.text: One simulated day, standard meals (model output)
Units: ghrelin pg/ml, leptin ng/ml, insulin uU/ml, GLP-1 and PYY pmol/l, cortisol ug/dl, glucose mg/dl. Simulation, not data.
